data.long_meaning: The name Cerys has several meanings in Welsh. It can mean 'Dark', 'Wise', 'Bright', 'Silent', 'Beautiful', or 'Cherry Tree'. The name is associated with fairies and music, and is often given to girls born under the sign of Taurus or Cancer. The name Cerys carries the meaning “Dark, Wise, Bright, Silent, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Cerys usually hope their child will grow to embody dark, wise, bright, silent, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
